source: Live GitHub issue-list read across all states; criterion order and exact text retained. Closed accepted issues remain in the source comparison.
purpose: Living evidence index: 21 reviewed documentary/design criteria for Android #20/#23/#24/#25/#34/#35/#47 are complete; 420 criteria remain incomplete. This does not replace acceptance receipts, GitHub issue status or native dependencies.

pr-131.scope_limit: Reviewed proposals only; product/framework/service receiving decisions and operating commitments remain separate.

pr-132.scope_limit: Data-flow and threat design, not security acceptance of an installed application.

pr-133.scope_limit: JVM parsing, frozen schema validation, exact decimal values and stale-callback protection; no complete application journey.

pr-134.scope_limit: Hash-first exact contract inventory and tamper rejection; not new-contract approval or measured evidence.

pr-135.scope_limit: Verified atomic local artifact cache under documented filesystem/cooperating-writer limits; no Android power-loss or production publication acceptance.

pr-136.scope_limit: Unsigned synthetic diagnostic APK and Android build/lint lane; not installed-device, signed release or complete builder evidence.

pr-137.scope_limit: Exact HTTPS-host navigation candidates only; no Android intent integration, verified App Links or redirect confinement.

pr-138.scope_limit: Merged in-memory immutable draft/revision history with independent optional tiers; not durable storage or Android process-death recovery.

pr-139.scope_limit: Merged evidence presentation and snapshot freshness policy; not real-source receiving acceptance or integrated user-interface evidence.

pr-140.scope_limit: Merged interactive synthetic diagnostic; not a durable builder, installed-device acceptance or production catalog evidence.

pr-165.scope_limit: Current-token format-2 saves deduplicate unchanged content/metadata without a cache write or new revision; stale tokens conflict and explicit restore/v1 migration remain distinct. 159 JVM tests and final CI passed. This is local persistence evidence, not autosave, installed Android recreation or full #67/#122 receiving acceptance.

pr-168.scope_limit: Canonical-root non-reentrant JVM guard preserves the active library creator process lock after local contention. A separate-JVM regression failed on e213ac2c and passed the repair; 167 JVM tests passed. This does not establish complete library operations, Android process/device qualification or power-loss safety.

pr-208.scope_limit: Incomplete workload format-3 storage with exact optional values, supported legacy migration, CAS/history preservation and bounded failure handling. Final combined 248 core tests and 17 simulated Activity cases passed; no installed-device, power-loss or full storage acceptance.

pr-218.scope_limit: Native workload form with exact valid pending values, invalid/rejected-input save blockade and recreation/CAS handling, integrated with terminal editor guards. Final 253 core tests and 25 simulated Activity cases passed; no placement, real-data readiness, process-death or device acceptance.

pr-222.scope_limit: Explicit local new-identity copy of valid pending inputs and disclosed captured-baseline content, leaving newer original unchanged. Final 257 core tests and 27 simulated Activity cases passed; no remote merge/authorization, durable unresolved-conflict journal, process-death or account-transition acceptance.

pr-234.scope_limit: Bounded synthetic exact item/version/snapshot details, typed specs/license/provenance and conservative missing-rate presentation. The final reviewed tree passed frozen/core checks and strict unsigned assembly/lint with all 35 required simulated Activity cases. No real-source acceptance, specific offering/pricebook applicability join, external navigation, installed historical recovery or named receiving acceptance is established.

pr-279.scope_limit: Complete planned Android data-inventory/threat-model design and mitigation handoff for the three exact #23 criteria, with ADR 0001 placement and independent reviews 5562297375/5562386507. Current-source reconciliation is pinned separately to 8162a5571147874635d3139e73a171a1077a6d2b. This does not accept any real-data rights/publication, remote service or operator commitment, installed/physical-device security, privacy-law conclusion, signing, Play distribution or release outcome.

pr-297.scope_limit: Accepted Android #20/#24/#34 product, MVP and native-foundation decision records, exact criterion mappings and ADR 0002 placement, with independent delegated product/Android technical receiving review. Evidence and hypotheses remain distinct. This accepts nine literal design criteria; execution of the selected journeys, participant evidence, real-data/source-rights qualification, service activation, installed/physical-device behavior, store and release delivery retain their own requirements.

pr-322.scope_limit: Accepted Android #25 guest-local, accounts, revenue, analytics, diagnostic and notification applicability decision, exact three-criterion mapping and ADR 0003 placement, with independent delegated product/Android technical receiving review. This accepts the documented enable/defer/reject and canonical remote-authorization decisions. The source retains explicit demand/value hypotheses, counterfactual disabled-service walkthroughs and current policy applicability limits. Account/service implementation, support destination, telemetry, purchases, notification behavior, participant evidence, installed devices and store/release/operating acceptance retain their own requirements.

pr-318.scope_limit: Accepted Android #47 qualification and ownership baseline decision, A01–A13 requirements and measurement/artifact methods, selected device/API/window targets, exact criterion mapping and narrowly scoped ADR 0004 placement, with actual independent source and delegated product/Android receiving reviews. This accepts three literal design outcomes. Physical equipment and installed-device results, measured performance/resource/capacity budgets, participant or source-rights/data qualification, future publisher/support/operating commitments, store and production release retain their separate prerequisites; no selected target is represented as an observed result.

pr-347.scope_limit: Accepted Android #35 service and hosting decision, one canonical Node API and managed PostgreSQL topology, explicit per-client stateful responsibility and activation mapping, source-qualified recovery/credential/isolation assumptions and narrowly scoped ADR 0005 placement. Actual independent product/Android and Apple affected-client reviews accept the three literal decision outcomes, including the explicitly open O1 operating-acceptance gate permitted by the issue. O1–O6 remain activation requirements: no person has accepted future operations, and no live endpoint, purchase, credential custody, deployment, restore, private-data handling, installed device or release is established. Canonical website and Research interfaces remain shared authority; Android receiving work is not a prerequisite for another accepted client. All prior execution receipts retain their actual checkout and limits.
